description: Calendar trigger event published by mod-notification-center once a day per tenant and storage module. It lists the calendar-based intents to check and the exact dates that raise them

tenant.description: Tenant the event is published for

targetModule.description: Module that stores the records the rules apply to, e.g. mod-invoice-storage

businessDate.description: The day the reminders are for, in the tenant's time zone (YYYY-MM-DD)

rules.description: Calendar-based intents and the dates that raise them
